attempts.sql: WITH cmd AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND name = 'Command' AND kind = 'class'), cmd_methods AS (SELECT s.name FROM code.symbols s JOIN cmd c ON s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' WHERE s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname LIKE 'Command.%' AND s.qualname NOT LIKE 'Command.%.%'), grp AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND name = 'Group' AND kind = 'class') SELECT DISTINCT g.symbol_id FROM code.symbols g JOIN grp ON g.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' JOIN cmd_methods cm ON g.name = cm.name WHERE g.kind = 'method' AND g.qualname LIKE 'Group.%' AND g.qualname NOT LIKE 'Group.%.%'

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds methods defined directly in the Command class body in src/click/core.py, then returns the symbol IDs of Group methods in the same file whose names match one of those Command methods, treating __init__ as an override.
sql: WITH cmd AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND name = 'Command' AND kind = 'class'), cmd_methods AS (SELECT s.name FROM code.symbols s JOIN cmd c ON s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' WHERE s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname LIKE 'Command.%' AND s.qualname NOT LIKE 'Command.%.%'), grp AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND name = 'Group' AND kind = 'class') SELECT DISTINCT g.symbol_id FROM code.symbols g JOIN grp ON g.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' JOIN cmd_methods cm ON g.name = cm.name WHERE g.kind = 'method' AND g.qualname LIKE 'Group.%' AND g.qualname NOT LIKE 'Group.%.%'
